verdicts.quote: Each invoice can have at most one accepted automatic reminder delivery
verdicts.missing: C-8 says reminders begin only after the deadline, so none go out before it, and C-17 declines to set a cadence. A builder would still have to decide how long after the due date the single reminder is sent.

verdicts.quote: An invoice with zero outstanding balance after a recorded settlement produces no automatic reminder.
verdicts.missing: Paid (C-4), part-paid (C-5) and voided (C-7) are decided. Disputed invoices, invoices on a payment plan, and whether a credit counts as settlement are not.

verdicts.quote: Once a delivery service accepts an invoice's automatic reminder, later checks, overlapping checks, or replayed work do not cause another accepted automatic reminder for that invoice.
When an eligibility-changing update takes effect before handoff, a pending reminder for the now-ineligible invoice is withheld.
If the delivery service confirms a temporary rejection and the invoice remains eligible, the service makes a later delivery attempt without a manual send.
verdicts.missing: No retry count or delay is chosen. Nothing says a person is alerted when temporary failures keep happening.

verdicts.quote: When more invoices qualify than a check can process, the remaining invoices are considered over subsequent checks
verdicts.missing: The provider's rate limit is not mentioned, and nothing says how sends are paced within a check to stay under it.

verdicts.quote: After activation, an invoice issued before the feature was installed can receive a reminder under the same conditions as a later invoice without being reissued.
verdicts.missing: Nothing says whether the existing overdue backlog is spread out or limited when the feature is switched on, rather than all going out at once.

verdicts.quote: the invoice is not overdue at any time on that date in the billing time zone
verdicts.missing: Time zone is decided only for when the due date passes. Sending hours, the customer's local time, weekends and holidays are not addressed.

verdicts.quote: An invoice whose billing address is blank or malformed produces no automatic delivery attempt until it has a usable destination.
A reminder is addressed to the current billing email applicable to the invoice
verdicts.missing: The clause assumes a single billing email. Nothing says which contact, or how many, receive the reminder when an invoice has several.

verdicts.quote: The operator can look up whether a reminder was accepted for delivery, skipped, rejected, or has an uncertain result for a particular invoice that was processed.
verdicts.missing: The record of when a reminder was sent and what it contained is not specified, nor is whether it is shown on the invoice itself.

verdicts.quote: The recipient can use the reminder to distinguish the invoiced obligation from their other invoices.
verdicts.missing: The amount, the due date, a way to pay, and whether a payment link expires are not specified.

verdicts.quote: A caller without permission to manage reminders for the affected billing scope receives a refusal when they try to change its setting.
verdicts.missing: Only enabling and disabling are covered. Nothing says who may configure the timing, or who may send or stop an individual reminder by hand.

verdicts.quote: An authorized operator disables reminders for the records they manage and can see that the setting is inactive.
verdicts.missing: The off switch is per billing scope only, with nothing global and nothing per customer. Preview or dry-run is absent. Manual resend is only implied by C-42's existing manual communications.

verdicts.quote: For a skipped or rejected reminder, the operator can determine the cause known to the service
verdicts.missing: What failed is visible. Nothing lets an operator see which reminders are scheduled to go out next.

verdicts.quote: When more invoices qualify than a check can process
verdicts.missing: A per-check capacity exists but has no value. Nothing limits how late a reminder may go out; C-33 lets missed work be sent after any delay.

verdicts.quote: The same invoice creation inputs are accepted or refused under the same existing rules with reminders active or inactive.
